units.source_text: 在温泉客栈听按摩女谈艺妓的身世，那是太平常了。

en.t: To hear a masseuse at a hot-spring inn talk about a geisha's life story was all too ordinary.

units.source_text: 惟其平常，反而出乎意料。

en.t: Precisely because it was so ordinary, it was unexpectedly surprising.

units.source_text: 驹子为了未婚夫出来当艺妓，本也是平凡无奇的事，但岛村总觉得难以相信。

en.t: That Komako had gone out to become a geisha for her fiance was, in itself, nothing unusual, but Shimamura still found it hard to believe.

units.source_text: 那也许是与道德观念互相抵触的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps that was because it conflicted with his sense of morality.
